limits: operator new is a native heap allocation stand-in.
operator delete is a native heap release stand-in.
realloc is a scripted native CRT allocation boundary; cases preserve copied bytes and allocation lifetime.
lstrlenA is a scripted Windows string-length boundary.
InterlockedDecrement is a scripted Windows atomic decrement boundary.
Registry/index algorithms are reused through the read-only core registerBinding bridge; only the 11 listed registration entries are owned here.
Callbacks are stored as addresses and are not executed or owned by this family.
Original table growth failure faults in the saved-EBP diagnostic read at address 4 before any normal zero-return continuation.
notes: The 11 seeded registration entries use typed LogicStateRegistry descriptors and the existing core registerBinding bridge; auxiliary core sources provide linkage without adding core-owned addresses. Parent registrations and CString routines remain original code at their physical boundaries.
